decision_question: Can the frozen candidate be handed to Kieran as a controlled pre-production release without claiming universal reliability, completed account transfer, or offline support?
acceptance_criteria: Artifact identity, hashes, criteria, evidence, and review record are frozen together.
Independent evidence, outcome, safety and portability reviews are compared.
A targeted falsification pass tests the strongest release conclusion.
Critical and high risks have owners, mitigations, decisive evidence, and expiry triggers.
Handoff covers accounts, secrets, deployment, recovery, privacy, and support without credentials.

shared_model_or_source_limits: Reviewers read the same repository snapshot.
Reviews were produced in one model environment, so agreement is correlated.
No external human reviewer or protected holdout was available.

initial_reviews.finding: Install, build, artifact, source privacy, and source read-only boundaries are evidenced; live deployment and runtime lifecycle evidence are absent.
The handoff is actionable, but ownership transfer and end-to-end user journeys remain unchecked.
Source boundaries are credible, but storage write failures, manual accessibility, third-party behavior, and published Pages behavior remain unproven.

concordance: material agreement on bounded code/build readiness and missing runtime/manual evidence

falsification_hypotheses: Published Pages may serve stale or broken hash-route assets.
A second Google account may expose the first account's namespace.
Full or private browser storage may silently lose edits.
Manual keyboard, screen-reader, zoom, contrast, or touch defects may survive source checks.

test_results.next_test: Smoke-test the published URL, every hash route, and required assets.
Run a disposable two-account switch with storage inventory.
Force unavailable/full storage and observe user-visible recovery.
Complete the manual accessibility matrix on phone and desktop.

decisive_evidence: Pushed candidate and matching local/origin main hashes.
Portable npm ci with unchanged lockfile.
Passing type-check, source accessibility check, production build, artifact check, and clean preview.
unresolved_items: Real Google OAuth lifecycle and account isolation

limitations: Public stable/v1.0 approval is deferred for the unresolved items.
Offline use is not supported or claimed because no service worker exists.
No account transfer or Google production verification has been performed.

follow_up.checks: Published Pages, Google lifecycle, manual accessibility, storage failure, and handoff rehearsal
follow_up.expiry_trigger: Any release, route, persistence, OAuth, external endpoint, workflow, or ownership change
